description: Page through the Google Photos library timeline, newest first: media key, taken/uploaded time, dimensions, photo or video (+duration), favorite flag and a thumbnail URL. Optional date range (after/before) and type filter. Pass next_page_token to continue.

after.description: Only items taken on/after this time: YYYY-MM-DD, ISO-8601 UTC, or epoch ms.

before.description: Only items taken on/before this time (a bare date includes the whole day).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email whose Google Photos library to use (e.g. the one at /u/1/). Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user; do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

page_size.description: Target number of items, 1-500 (default 100). Google pages in its own chunk sizes, so a call can return somewhat more; keep paging with next_page_token.

page_token.description: next_page_token from the previous list_media call.

name: list_media
